title: Adshade Street bridge over the R71, Tzaneen (approx.): burst asbestos water main, repair waiting on a pipe from Cape Town, reported 19 Oct
summary: A water pipe burst along the original pipeline near the Adshade Street bridge over the R71 in Tzaneen, leaving residents with water supply problems (Letaba Herald, 19 October). Greater Tzaneen Municipality DA councillor ...
story: A water pipe burst along the original pipeline near the Adshade Street bridge over the R71 in Tzaneen, leaving residents with water supply problems (Letaba Herald, 19 October). Greater Tzaneen Municipality DA councillor Chrisma Bredenkamp said the damaged asbestos pipe is being replaced with steel; the replacement pipe has to come from Cape Town. Workers could not reach the section through the tunnel under the bridge and had to open the area above the pipeline. When the pipe burst is not stated, so the date is the report date. The arrival date of the pipe and the completion date were not confirmed; the municipality's spokesperson had not replied by publication. One report. The pin is approximate (street level).
incident: Burst date not stated; repairs were under way and incomplete when reported on Mon 19 Oct 2026 (Letaba Herald). The pin date is the report date.
location_note: Near the Adshade Street bridge over the R71 in Tzaneen (Letaba Herald). The pin is the middle of Adshade Street from OpenStreetMap, inside the Tzaneen police precinct; the exact spot where the street crosses the R71 could not be read from the map. Approximate, street level (about 800 m).
